display_name.description: The name of this instance configuration as it appears in UIs.
display_name.rationale: The display name is a required identifier for the instance configuration. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should follow naming conventions for clarity.

replicas.description: The geographic placement of nodes in this instance configuration and their replication properties.
replicas.rationale: Replica placement determines where data is physically stored. Misconfigured replicas can result in data being stored in regions that do not comply with data residency or sovereignty requirements.

location.description: The location of the serving resources, e.g. us-central1.
location.rationale: The replica location determines the physical region where data is stored. It should be set to a region that complies with data residency and sovereignty requirements.

type.description: Indicates the type of replica. Possible values are: READ_WRITE, READ_ONLY, WITNESS.
type.rationale: The replica type affects availability and performance but does not directly introduce a security risk.

default_leader_location.description: If true, this location is designated as the default leader location where leader replicas are placed.
default_leader_location.rationale: The default leader location affects performance and latency but does not directly introduce a security risk.

name.description: A unique identifier for the instance configuration.
name.rationale: The instance configuration name is an optional identifier. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should follow naming conventions to avoid confusion.

base_config.description: Base configuration name, e.g. nam3, based on which this configuration is created. Only set for user managed configurations.
base_config.rationale: The base configuration determines the foundation for the custom instance configuration. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should reference a trusted Google-managed configuration.

labels.description: An object containing a list of key-value pairs for labelling the instance configuration.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for organisation and cost allocation. They do not directly introduce a security risk but can be used to enforce governance policies.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project field is optional and defaults to the provider project. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should be explicitly set to avoid deploying resources to unintended projects.
